skill.description: Guide for creating high-quality MCP servers that connect AI agents to external services through well-designed tools, safe API patterns, and evaluation-driven development.

content.user_title: Build MCP Servers for AI Agents
content.value_statement: Building an MCP server requires protocol knowledge, safe tool design, and repeatable evaluation. This skill guides developers through planning, implementation, testing, and evaluation.
actual_capabilities: Guides research and planning for agent-centered MCP tool design.
Explains Python FastMCP and TypeScript SDK implementation patterns.
Provides an evaluation workflow and helper scripts for MCP tool tests.
Covers response formatting, pagination, truncation, and actionable errors.
Includes security, testing, and quality checklists for MCP servers.
limitations: Does not build the server automatically.
Requires external documentation access for current MCP and SDK details.
Evaluation scripts require Anthropic API access and Python dependencies.
Example services and API URLs must be adapted before production use.

use_cases.title: Plan an API Integration Server
use_cases.description: Map real user workflows into a focused MCP tool set before implementation begins.

use_cases.title: Implement Python or TypeScript Tools
use_cases.description: Use language-specific guidance for schemas, shared API clients, error handling, and tool annotations.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Agent Tool Quality
use_cases.description: Create realistic read-only questions and run them through the included evaluation harness.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Basic MCP Server
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new integration.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use mcp-builder to plan a read-only MCP server for [service]. Identify workflows, tool names, inputs, outputs, and error cases.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Python Implementation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use mcp-builder to design a Python FastMCP server for [service]. Include shared helpers, Pydantic models, pagination, and response formatting.

prompt_templates.title: Review a TypeScript Server
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of an existing server.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use mcp-builder to review my TypeScript MCP server. Check Zod schemas, tool annotations, async requests, error handling, build steps, and tests.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Evaluation Suite
prompt_templates.prompt: Use mcp-builder to create an advanced evaluation plan for [service]. Include ten read-only questions, verification steps, success criteria, and improvement loops.

output_examples.input: User asks for planning help for a GitHub MCP server.
output_examples.output: A structured implementation plan covering target workflows, authentication, response formats, pagination, error cases, and evaluation questions.

output_examples.input: User asks to review a Python MCP server design.
output: Search responses should offer concise and detailed formats.
Authentication errors need clearer recovery guidance.

output_examples.input: User asks to prepare evaluations for an MCP server.
output_examples.output: Ten realistic read-only evaluation tasks with stable expected answers and a repeatable report workflow.

best_practices: Start with real workflows, then design tools that complete those workflows.
Use strict input schemas and clear, actionable error messages.
Evaluate with stable read-only questions before expanding tool scope.
anti_patterns: Do not wrap every API endpoint as a separate tool without workflow design.
Do not return unbounded data when pagination or truncation is needed.
Do not mark tools as read-only when they can modify external systems.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps you design, implement, test, and evaluate MCP servers for external APIs and services.

faq.question: Does it support both Python and TypeScript?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for Python FastMCP and the TypeScript MCP SDK.

faq.question: Does it include runnable scripts?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a Python evaluation harness for testing MCP servers with read-only questions.

faq.question: Do I need API credentials?
faq.answer: Only when your target service or evaluation model requires them. Use placeholders in examples and protect real secrets.

faq.question: Can it replace official MCP documentation?
faq.answer: No. It directs users to official MCP and SDK documentation for current protocol details.

faq.question: Is it suitable for production servers?
faq.answer: It provides production-oriented guidance, but each server still needs security review, testing, and deployment hardening.
